privileged_info_for_vlm: The observer location must be Florence (43.7696N, 11.2558E). On Jan 7, 1610, at 19:00 UTC, three moons (Callisto, Io, and Europa) appear in a line to the east of Jupiter, while Ganymede is to the west. On Jan 8, 1610, at 19:00 UTC, all four moons are visible: Ganymede, Callisto, and Io are to the east, while Europa is to the west. The atmosphere and ground must be toggled off in the software settings.
